prototype_static_data.menu_rows: Generated menu_high_score_rows has 3 spans. menu_high_score_add_credits occupies the START GAME span width. menu_options_pairs remains generated; high-score pair data is absent.

existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.no_new_coin_consumer: src/presentation_runtime.s is unchanged from fe160; no duplicate A9-to-A8 consumer was added.
existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.foreground_reachability: src/main.s mainloop calls address $1900 every Vbord; complete-profile presentation_flow_tick at $1900 calls scan_keys; complete-profile scan_keys maps PAR5=$23 and calls MENU_SCAN; pft_ready consumes PRES_EVENT mask $06 before mode/menu dispatch.
existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.credit_update: Active complete-profile add_credit saturates at generated PRESENTATION_COIN_SLOT_COUNT=12, updates the existing credit byte and CREDIT_RF_HUD. Both simultaneous coin bits invoke add_credit twice, subject to the cap.
existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.menu_refresh: A coin event from the idle/high-score menu path reloads the high-score screen; menu_load_finish repaints from the authoritative credit byte. Existing coin-slot graphics are drawn from the same credit count. No separate numeric credit display was found in this source path.
existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.screen_entry_edge: Global key previous-state advances every scan. Local menu previous-state $DF updates only in local menu scan; attract IDs 0..2 skip that update. A held Enter across attract-to-high-score coin pre-emption can therefore publish a local Enter edge on first high-score scan if $DF was clear. Required entry/release scenario remains an implementation/runtime gate.
existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.capture_release: While capture is active key_scan clears PRES_EVENT before capture processing; candidate fixed coin IDs are rejected; capture waits until all sampled rows are released. Runtime verification remains required.
existing_runtime_contract_confirmed_from.source_identity: src/presentation_runtime.s, src/main.s, and src/keybinding_runtime.s baselines were source-inspected; the active coin consumer is the pre-existing presentation-flow path, not menu_scan itself.
